messages:
Maya Chen: Quick heads up — webinar landing needs SEO + routing checks. Live 04/12. Tasks: redirect map, JSON-LD event schema, internal linking from blog/docs, GA4 campaign params -> SFDC mapping. Can @Tom run a canonical audit?

Tom Alvarez: Yep. I'll run Screaming Frog and a canonical sweep tonight. Send me the GA4 export.

Priya Singh: Pasted top 15 GA4 paths in the doc: https://docs.google.com/... Draft hero: "See how Redwood Dedicated slashes latency and cost in production—live demo + benchmark walk-through." Shorten?

Alex R.: For leads, we'll add hidden utm_source, utm_campaign, demo_variant to the form and POST to /api/lead-proxy. Need fields list and a test webhook URL.

Maya Chen: Use utm_source, utm_medium, utm_campaign, gclid, demo_variant. Priya will give gated report link.

Priya Singh: Gated report: https://redwood.ai/reports/dedicated-benchmarks-2026 (will gate). Benchmark blurb: "Median p95 latency 110ms, cost per 1k tokens down 45% vs our baseline on demo set."

Tom Alvarez: Draft redirects:
```
/old-webinar -> /webinar-dedicated-2026 (301)
/blog/2024-inference-cost -> /blog/inference-cost-2026 (301)
/docs/serving-guide/v1 -> /docs/serving-guide/v2 (301)
```
I'll set canonical to /webinar-dedicated-2026 and run the crawl.

Alex R.: CMS snippets ready. I'll inject internal links from /blog/infra and /docs/deploy into the hero and FAQ. Also confirming CDN: ops-bot?

ops-bot: CDN window 04/10 00:00-04:00 UTC. 301s supported. Please file deploy ticket 24h prior.

Maya Chen: JSON-LD we want in head. Alex or Tom can add:
```
<script type="application/ld+json">{"@context":"https://schema.org","@type":"Event","name":"Redwood Dedicated Webinar","startDate":"2026-04-12T17:00:00Z","location":{"@type":"VirtualLocation","url":"https://redwood.ai/webinar-dedicated-2026"},"performer":[{"@type":"Person","name":"Priya Singh"}],"description":"Demo + benchmarks: production inference latency and cost optimizations."}</script>
```

Tom Alvarez: I'll drop that into the head template and run canonical checks after redirects are live.

Priya Singh: I'll update the hero copy in the sheet by 2pm and add the gated report CTA.

Maya Chen: Great — final owners: redirects & canon (Tom), JSON-LD + head (Tom), hero copy & gated link (Priya), CMS internal links & form fields (Alex). I'll send the launch one-pager after QA. React with :white_check_mark: when complete.
